title: RAG Docs Assistant
summary: Production RAG pipeline answering questions over 40K internal docs with 92% answer accuracy.
problem: Support team spent 6h/day searching internal documentation.
approach: Chunked docs (512 tokens), embedded with text-embedding-3-small, stored in pgvector, re-ranked with Cohere, answered via GPT-4o with citation enforcement.
result: Reduced support lookup time by 78%. Zero hallucination on citation-backed answers.

title: AI Code Reviewer
summary: GitHub Action that reviews PRs using LLMs with repo-context retrieval.
problem: Small team drowning in PR review backlog.
approach: Built context-aware reviewer: retrieves related code via AST + embeddings, then prompts Claude with diff + context. Rate-limited with Redis.
result: Cut median PR review time from 26h to 18h; caught 3 critical bugs pre-merge.

title: Agent Workflow Builder
summary: No-code builder for multi-agent workflows with visual debugging.
problem: Non-engineers couldn't compose multi-step AI tasks.
approach: DAG editor with LangGraph backend. Each node = tool or LLM call. Streaming execution trace in UI.
result: Enabled ops team to automate 40+ internal workflows without engineering.
